summaryFa: نقد اخم دیگری، نگاه واقعی به آینه، و آغاز رابطهٔ آرام‌تر.
storyFa: قرمز با اخم به اخم آبی اعتراض دارد. در قاب مستقل بعدی، واقعاً روبه‌آینه می‌ایستد و اخم خودش را می‌بیند. در پایان رفتار خودش را تغییر می‌دهد و با آبی گفت‌وگوی آرامی آغاز می‌کند.
meaningFa: پذیرفتن سهم خود در تنش دشوار است، اما تغییر رفتار خود می‌تواند رابطه را بهتر کند.

fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 narrative watercolor illustration for an adult Persian book. Three scenes show a tense person who criticizes another's frown, genuinely notices the own frown in a physically correct mirror, and improves the relationship by changing the own conduct.

LAYOUT AND CAST
Two equal upper scenes read RIGHT first, LEFT second, followed by one wide lower scene. Clear white gutters and soft irregular watercolor scene endings.
Exactly two medium adult neutral figures: RED is the main character, BLUE is the other person. Both have plain colored bodies, modest dark oval eyes, simple brows/mouths and no lashes or clothes. Colors, identities and proportions remain consistent.
A warm modest home entrance: pale cream walls, terracotta floor tiles, a wooden door with a small glazed upper window on the right, a restrained landscape picture, a wall hook rail holding a quiet grey-green coat, a small console table with one tiny plant, and a simple warm woven rug. A leafy potted plant appears toward the left. Furnishing supports the ordinary adult interaction and does not crowd the scene.

UPPER RIGHT: BLAMING THE OTHER PERSON
Red and blue stand fully visible on the woven rug, facing one another. Red's mouth is downturned, eyebrows tense, and one hand points impatiently toward blue. Blue has a modest worried frown and subdued posture. Red is looking directly at BLUE, with a thought bubble connected by small thought circles clearly to red. Exact thought:
"چرا اینقدر اخموئه؟"
Red's own face is visibly just as tense. NO MIRROR is present in this scene. Both full figures and both feet of each remain inside the frame, with breathing space beneath them.

UPPER LEFT: A REAL SELF-REFLECTION
Red alone has turned to FACE a flat rectangular wall mirror in a simple wooden frame. Camera is behind red, slightly to the side, showing the BACK of red's circular head and body. There are NO facial features on the back of the actual head. Actual red stands facing the glass, both arms lowered at the sides, two feet on the floor.
The mirror shows the SAME red figure's FRONT, with the matching frowning eyebrows and downturned mouth. Reflected head is round and correctly proportioned; reflected arms are lowered exactly like the real arms, not waving or pointing. Perspective and scale follow a plausible flat-mirror geometry: the reflected person is a virtual continuation behind the mirror plane, rather than an unrelated duplicate. Mirror frame and actual person's full body/feet are fully contained. Natural cropping of the reflection by the mirror frame is acceptable; actual feet must not touch or cross the scene edge.
Red is pausing uncomfortably on recognizing the own angry expression. A thought bubble clearly belongs to the REAL red figure, with exact text:
"خودمم اخم کردم..."
No blue figure in this self-reflection scene. No mirror paradox, additional person, back-of-head face or unmatched pose.

LOWER WIDE: CHANGING THE OWN BEHAVIOR
NO MIRROR here. The same red and blue stand fully visible in the same home entrance. Red approaches with relaxed brows, a kind small smile and open welcoming hands, inviting a calmer conversation. Blue's expression softens into a small relieved smile, hands gently resting together, listening.
A simple speech bubble has its tail clearly leading to RED. Exact words:
"بیا آروم حرف بزنیم."
The improved connection is caused by red changing the own conduct. Avoid a magic transformation, ridicule, dramatic reconciliation hug or moral lecture. Keep all bodies, both feet, rug and furniture within the painted margins.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
